chapters.label: The goal, live
chapters.text: Munich, Euro 2024: the Netherlands against Romania. Xavi Simons spins and finds Cody Gakpo on the left. He takes his defender toward the touchline... cuts back inside... shoots! Goal!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. Gakpo drives toward the line, and his defender follows. Then he cuts back inside, and the goal opens up.

chapters.label: Near post
chapters.text: He drills it low and fast, inside the near post. Florin Nita can't stop it. One-nil to the Netherlands!

chapters.label: How he does it
chapters.text: Now try his move. From the left wing, cut inside onto your right foot, and aim for the far corner.
